login.authentication: One-time code at login. Non-interactive SSH cannot answer it.
login.remote_access: Supported via OpenSSH connection multiplexing: the user opens one authenticated master connection (ssh -MNf <alias>) and later ssh/rsync sessions reuse it with no new prompt. Set ssh.host to that alias.
login.on_node_alternative: ssh.host = localhost when the agent runs on a Miyabi login node.
login.note: A sudden 'Permission denied (keyboard-interactive)' means the master expired; the user re-runs ssh -MNf <alias>. Never ask for the code.

scheduler.group_directive_note: The project group is never hardcoded: set spec.attributes.account, or configure defaults.group in ~/.hpc-agent/miyabi.json (or MIYABI_GROUP).
